name: app.himalayas/mcp
title: Himalayas Remote Jobs
description: Remote jobs: job search, salary data and application tracking, or post a job and hire candidates

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Browse the latest remote job listings with optional filtering by country or worldwide availability

worldwide.description: Show ONLY 100% remote jobs available worldwide (overrides country filter)

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search remote job listings on Himalayas by job title, role, skill or keyword, filtered by the countries a job is open to, worldwide availability, seniority, employment type, salary, markets, benefits or companies. Each result has the company, title, salary range when listed, the countries the job is open to, the posting date and the slugs for get_job_details.

keyword.description: Job title, role or skill to search for, e.g. 'product manager' or 'react' (optional)

exclude_worldwide.description: When true and country is set, return ONLY jobs specifically available in that country, excluding worldwide/remote jobs. Requires country to be set.

worldwide.description: Show ONLY 100% remote jobs available worldwide (overrides country filter)

experience.description: Filter by a single experience/seniority level (entry-level, mid-level, senior, manager, director, or executive)

type.description: Filter by a single employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor, temporary, intern, volunteer, or other)

salary_min.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD. Hourly, weekly and monthly pay is converted to a yearly figure first (hourly x 2080), so hourly jobs whose yearly equivalent clears it are included.

salary_max.description: Maximum yearly pay in USD, compared the same way as salary_min

currency.description: Salary currency (default: USD). salary_min and salary_max are always USD; this doesn't convert them.

salary_required.description: If false, include jobs without salary data in salary-filtered results (default: true — only jobs with salary)

markets.description: Comma-separated market/category slugs to filter by (e.g., 'saas,fintech,healthcare')

benefits.description: Comma-separated benefit slugs to filter by (e.g., '401k,health-insurance,equity')

companies.description: Comma-separated company slugs to filter by (e.g., 'stripe,gitlab')

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific job including description, requirements and salary. Use the company_slug and job_slug from job listings. To get the employer's application link, call get_apply_link.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL or company page)

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

tools.name: get_apply_link
tools.description: Get the employer's application link for a job, once the user has decided to apply. Some employers ask screening questions first: the reply then lists them instead of the link, and you call again with the user's own answers in screening_answers (never guess or invent an answer). It returns the link when the answers meet the employer's requirements, and no link when they don't. Uses the connected Himalayas account (no extra sign-in needed); limited to 50 links per account per day. Use the company_slug and job_slug from job listings.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL or company page)

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

screening_answers.description: The user's answers to this job's screening questions, only after a reply listed them

question_id.description: The question's ID from the screening questions

answer.description: true/false for yes/no questions, one of the listed options, or the user's own short text

tools.name: generate_application_documents
tools.description: Write a resume and cover letter tailored to a Himalayas job, from the user's Himalayas profile. Use it when the user's CV is generic, they have no cover letter, or an application form asks for one. They are saved to the user's account, where the user can edit them and download a PDF. A free account gets one tailored resume and one cover letter in total; Himalayas Plus includes them for every job. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed. Use the company_slug and job_slug from job listings.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL or company page)

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

tools.name: get_new_matches
tools.description: Get jobs matching the user's Himalayas profile that were posted since an agent last checked, leaving out jobs already in their tracker. The check-in point is saved on the account, so it carries across sessions and agents; a first check looks back 7 days. Plus members get the jobs; free accounts get how many there are. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: skip_job
tools.description: Record that the user is passing on a Himalayas job, with the reason, so it stops coming back in get_new_matches and future matches can learn from it. job_closed also reports the listing as expired. For a job already in the tracker, use update_job_status with outcome didnt_apply instead. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL)

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

reason.description: Why the user is passing on it

detail.description: Anything worth knowing, in a sentence or two (what the page said, a hidden requirement). No personal data.

tools.name: get_plus_checkout_link
tools.description: Get a Stripe checkout link for Himalayas Plus (US$9 a month) when the user wants to subscribe. Plus includes tailored resumes and cover letters for every job; 30 minutes a month of spoken mock interviews for a specific job, scored out of 100 (sessions of 90 seconds or more) and saved so the user can track their progress; new job matches between sessions (get_new_matches); a higher place in employer talent search on the himalayas.app website (not in search_talent results through this connector, which have no paid placement); identity and work permit verification every 30 days, with a verified badge (work permits need a passport or national ID); and a career coach. Details: https://himalayas.app/plus. The user opens the link and pays on Stripe themselves; this tool never charges them. Applying through Himalayas is free without Plus. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: join_radar_waitlist
tools.description: Join the waitlist for Himalayas Radar, a plan for people who are employed or not actively searching: alerts only for roles that beat their bar, a private open-to-offers mode with their current employer hidden, and a monthly salary check. Radar isn't available yet, so there is nothing to pay; Himalayas emails the user when it launches. Call it only if the user wants to join. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_related_jobs
tools.description: Find jobs similar to a specific job, based on skills, location, and category. Use after viewing a job to suggest alternatives.

company_slug.description: Company slug of the original job

job_slug.description: Job slug of the original job

tools.name: get_companies
tools.description: Browse remote-friendly companies with optional filtering by country or worldwide availability

worldwide.description: Show only companies with 100% remote jobs available worldwide (overrides country filter)

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search for remote-friendly companies using keywords with optional country filtering

worldwide.description: Show only companies with 100% remote jobs available worldwide (overrides country filter)

benefits.description: Comma-separated benefit slugs to filter by (e.g., '401k,health-insurance,equity')

tech_stack.description: Comma-separated technology slugs to filter by (e.g., 'react,typescript,python')

tools.name: get_company_details
tools.description: Get full details for a company including about, tech stack, benefits, open positions, and social links

tools.name: get_remote_work_statistics
tools.description: Get remote work statistics: top skills, job categories, industries, or countries by job/company count.

record.description: What to get stats for: 'jobs' or 'companies' (default: jobs)

type.description: Type of breakdown: 'skills', 'categories', 'countries', or 'industries' (default: skills). 'industries' only works with record='companies'.

tools.name: get_salary_data
tools.description: Get salary benchmarks for remote jobs by job title, with optional seniority and country filters. Returns min, max, and median salary in USD.

job_title.description: Job title to look up salary for (e.g., 'software-engineer', 'product-manager', 'data-scientist'). Use hyphens instead of spaces.

tools.name: get_correct_country_name
tools.description: Resolve a country name to the correct format accepted by Himalayas filters. Useful for fuzzy matching user input.

country_string.description: The country name to get the correct name for

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a problem report about Himalayas to its engineering team: a missing capability (filter, field, tool), unclear or wrong documentation, a surprising response, an unhelpful error, a bug, a blocked page or action, or impractical performance. Describe the goal, what got in the way and, if known, a suggested fix. Fill `agent` with the client's name and model. Reports must not contain credentials, personal data or the user's private content.

goal.description: What you or your user were trying to accomplish, in plain language

message.description: What prevented or complicated the task

endpoint.description: The Himalayas tool involved, e.g. search_jobs

outcome.description: blocked = task failed, degraded = completed worse or slower, completed = suggestion only

expected.description: What you expected to find or happen

suggestion.description: A concrete change that would have let you succeed

session_id.description: Reuse the same value for every report in one task

agent.description: Who is reporting: name (agent or product) and model

evidence.description: Sanitized details of the failing call, with no credentials or personal data

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get your Himalayas profile information. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save a job to your application tracker. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List every job in the user's Himalayas job application tracker with its status (saved, applied, interviewing, negotiation, hired, archived), outcome, salary, notes and links, for tracking applications and seeing where each one stands. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_job_status
tools.description: Update a saved job's status, outcome or details. Use status for where the application is now (interviewing, negotiation for an offer, hired). Use outcome for an applied job that ended without progressing: rejected, no_response (no reply after 45+ days), withdrawn, or didnt_apply; status stays as it is. With didnt_apply, give a reason: job_closed reports the listing as expired, and the rest improve the user's future matches. Add detail for anything worth knowing (what the page said, a hidden requirement). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

outcome.description: What happened after applying, as reported by the user. "clear" removes a recorded outcome.

reason.description: Why the user didn't apply (only with outcome didnt_apply)

detail.description: Anything worth knowing about the outcome, in a sentence or two. No personal data.

tools.name: remove_saved_job
tools.description: Remove a job from your application tracker. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update your Himalayas profile. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

first_name.description: First name, as shown on the profile and tailored resumes

username.description: New username: 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dashes or underscores. The profile moves to himalayas.app/@username and the old link stops working.

location.description: Country name (e.g. 'United States', 'Australia'). Cities and 'City, Country' strings are not accepted.

career_description.description: Description of what you're looking for

career_working_permits.description: Countries the user can legally work in, as country names (e.g. ['United States']). Replaces the current list.

career_skill_list.description: Skills for job matching (e.g. ['Product design', 'User research']). Replaces the current list.

career_compensation.description: How the user feels about equity as part of pay

contact_email.description: Email shown to employers, if different from the login email

email_visible.description: Show the contact email on the profile

visibility.description: public_profile: employers can find and view it. unsearchable_profile: viewable by link but not in search. private_profile: only the user sees it.

career_interested_role_list.description: Other roles the user is interested in. Replaces the current list.

seniority.description: Seniority levels the user wants. Replaces the current list.

career_company_size.description: Company size preferences, e.g. {'1-10': 'not_interested', '51-200': 'preferred'}. Replaces all current size preferences, so include every size the user cares about.

tools.name: add_experience
tools.description: Add a work experience to your Himalayas profile. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

description.description: Description of your role and responsibilities

location.description: Country name for this role (e.g. 'United States', 'Germany'). Cities are not accepted.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD format, omit for current role)

current_job.description: Whether this is your current job

experience_skill_list.description: Comma-separated skills used in this role

tools.name: add_education
tools.description: Add an education entry to your Himalayas profile. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_experience
tools.description: Edit a work experience on your Himalayas profile by id (get_my_profile lists the ids). Only the fields you pass change. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

location.description: Country name for this role. Cities are not accepted.

current_job.description: Whether this is the current job

experience_skill_list.description: Skills used in this role. Replaces the current list.

tools.name: delete_experience
tools.description: Delete a work experience from your Himalayas profile by id. This can't be undone: confirm with the user first. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_education
tools.description: Edit an education entry on your Himalayas profile by id (get_my_profile lists the ids). Only the fields you pass change. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: delete_education
tools.description: Delete an education entry from your Himalayas profile by id. This can't be undone: confirm with the user first. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_email_preferences
tools.description: Turn Himalayas emails on or off for the user. Only the settings you pass change. Daily job-match emails are a Plus feature; free accounts get weekly. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

job_matches.description: Emails with new jobs that match the profile

job_match_frequency.description: How often job-match emails come (daily needs Plus)

application_followups.description: 'Did you hear back?' emails about applications

message_notifications.description: Emails when an employer messages them

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Change the user's account time zone (used for email timing). Name is on update_profile; email address and password can only be changed on himalayas.app. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

time_zone.description: Time zone name, e.g. 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)' or 'London'

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the user's tailored resumes and cover letters on Himalayas, newest first, with ids and edit links. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

type.description: Only resumes or only cover letters (default: both)

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read one of the user's tailored resumes or cover letters by id (from list_documents). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Rename a tailored resume or cover letter, or replace a cover letter's text. Resume content is edited in the website's resume editor (link from list_documents). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

content.description: Cover letters only: the full new text, paragraphs separated by blank lines

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete one of the user's tailored resumes or cover letters. This can't be undone: confirm with the user first. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: import_profile
tools.description: Fill in the user's Himalayas profile from their LinkedIn profile URL or their resume text. Runs in the background for a few minutes; get_my_profile shows the result. append_only adds what's missing and keeps what's there; replace_all overwrites the profile, so ask the user first. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

linkedin_url.description: Their LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/name

resume_text.description: The full text of their resume

tools.name: update_profile_photo
tools.description: Set the user's profile photo (avatar) or profile cover photo from an image URL (https, JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF, up to 5 MB). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_billing_portal_link
tools.description: Get a link to the user's Stripe billing page, where they can update their card, see invoices, or change or cancel Himalayas Plus themselves. Only for users who have paid before. Never act on billing for them. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_interviews
tools.description: List the user's interview practice on Himalayas: each job they practised for, when, and the link to practise again, plus the voice minutes and credits they have left. get_interview_results shows the scores. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_interview_results
tools.description: Get the scores and feedback from the user's interview practice for one job: each answer's rating and feedback, and for voice sessions the overall score, what went well, what to improve, next steps and length. Pass the interview id from list_interviews, or the job's company_slug and job_slug. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_interview_practice_link
tools.description: Get the Himalayas page where the user practises interviewing for a specific job: a Himalayas job (company_slug and job_slug) or a job elsewhere (application_link). On that page the user has a live spoken mock interview with an AI interviewer playing the company's hiring manager, with questions built from the job and their profile, then gets a score out of 100 with what went well and what to improve (sessions of 90 seconds or more are scored). Sessions and scores are saved to the account, so the user can see how they improve over time (list_interviews, get_interview_results). Free accounts include one text mock interview; spoken interviews are part of Himalayas Plus (30 minutes a month). Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

company_slug.description: Company slug of a Himalayas job

job_slug.description: Job slug of a Himalayas job

application_link.description: https link to a job posted somewhere else

tools.name: get_verification_link
tools.description: Get the next step for verifying the user's identity and work permits on Himalayas (the verified badge): whether they are verified, and otherwise the Stripe Identity link (when verification is included, as on Plus or Max) or a US$5 checkout link. Use it when the user wants to get verified: when verification is included, this starts it (a Plus or Max member's included verification is then used for 30 days). A passport or national ID verifies identity and the work permit for that country; other IDs verify identity only. get_my_profile shows whether they are verified. The user opens each link and does the verification or payment on Stripe themselves. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_saved_answers
tools.description: List the answers the user saved to job application questions on Himalayas (for example work authorisation or notice period), with ids. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_saved_answer
tools.description: Change the text of one of the user's saved application answers, by id from list_saved_answers. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: delete_saved_answer
tools.description: Delete one of the user's saved application answers. This can't be undone: confirm with the user first. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List the user's newest Himalayas notifications (up to 20), such as finished headshots, profile imports and community replies, with ids and whether each is read. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark one of the user's Himalayas notifications as read by id, or all of them with all: true. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

all.description: true marks every notification as read

tools.name: list_coach_chats
tools.description: List the user's conversations with the Himalayas career coach, newest first, with titles, dates and links. get_coach_chat reads one. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_coach_chat
tools.description: Read one of the user's career coach conversations by slug from list_coach_chats. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_headshots
tools.description: List the AI headshots the user has made on Himalayas, newest first: each session's finished images with ids and URLs, and a link to see them. use_headshot_as_profile_photo sets one as the profile photo. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: use_headshot_as_profile_photo
tools.description: Set one of the user's finished AI headshots as their Himalayas profile photo, by session id and image id from list_headshots. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_headshots_link
tools.description: Get the Himalayas page where the user makes AI headshots from a few photos of themselves. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_tech_stack
tools.description: Set the tools and technologies on your Himalayas profile, replacing the current list. Names are matched to Himalayas' catalogue; any it doesn't have yet are requested for review and left off for now. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: search_talent
tools.description: Search remote candidates and talent on Himalayas to hire or recruit, such as developers, designers or marketers, by skill, job title or keyword and country. Each result has the candidate's current role, salary expectation, job search status and the profile link for get_talent_profile. Results here have no paid placement: they are ordered by relevance or recency only, and Himalayas Plus or verified candidates rank like everyone else. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_talent_profile
tools.description: Get full details for a candidate including bio, all experiences, education, tech stack, social links, and more. Use the talent_slug from search_talent results. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

talent_slug.description: Talent slug from search_talent (e.g. 'john-doe'). Also accepts '@john-doe' or a himalayas.app/@slug profile URL.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get your company's profile on Himalayas. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: update_company_profile
tools.description: Update your company's profile on Himalayas. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

location_list.description: Comma-separated list of locations (e.g., 'San Francisco, New York')

tools.name: get_company_perks
tools.description: Get your company's perks/benefits on Himalayas. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: add_company_perk
tools.description: Add a perk/benefit to your company on Himalayas. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: remove_company_perk
tools.description: Remove a perk/benefit from your company on Himalayas. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

id.description: Perk ID to remove (use get_company_perks to find IDs)

tools.name: update_company_tech_stack
tools.description: Update your company's tech stack on Himalayas. Pass technology names (e.g., 'React', 'Python') and they'll be matched to the Himalayas stack database. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_company_jobs
tools.description: List your company's job postings on Himalayas. Shows status, views, clicks, and expiry. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: show_company_job
tools.description: Get full details of one of your company's job postings on Himalayas. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: create_company_job
tools.description: Post a remote job on Himalayas for the user's company, to hire remote staff. Posting a job is free; it needs admin approval before going live, and can also be saved as a draft. The optional extras are paid: sticky ($299) and newsletter ($99). With any extras, the reply is a Stripe checkout link the user opens and pays themselves, and the job doesn't go live until that payment completes; without extras nothing is charged. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

description.description: Job description (350+ characters, can include HTML)

app_link_or_email.description: Application URL or email address — backend auto-detects via @ check

valid_through.description: Expiration date (ISO format, defaults to 30 days from now)

draft.description: Save as draft instead of submitting for approval

correct_option.description: Index of correct option (for mpc type)

extras.description: Paid extras: 'sticky' ($299 pin to top for 30 days), 'newsletter' ($99 feature in weekly email for 30 days)

tools.name: update_company_job
tools.description: Update an existing job posting on Himalayas. Only provide fields you want to change. For screening_questions, provide the full set — questions not included will be removed. Editing is free. If the job has paid extras (sticky or newsletter, chosen earlier) that aren't paid yet, the reply is a Stripe checkout link for them, which the user opens and pays themselves; nothing is charged otherwise. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

description.description: Job description (350+ characters, can include HTML)

draft.description: Save as draft instead of submitting for approval

screening_questions.description: Screening questions — provide full set, questions not included will be removed

id.description: Existing question ID (omit for new questions)

tools.name: delete_company_job
tools.description: Delete a job posting from your company on Himalayas. This action cannot be undone, and any paid extras on the posting go with it. Deleting takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is deleted, and the reply shows the posting with a confirm_token; calling again with the same job_slug and that token deletes it. Show the user the posting and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

confirm_token.description: Leave out to see what would be deleted; nothing is deleted. Pass the token from that reply to delete it

tools.name: purchase_job_extras
tools.description: Purchase paid extras for an existing job posting: sticky ($299), newsletter ($99). Returns a Stripe checkout URL. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

job_slug.description: Job slug to add extras to

extras.description: Extras to purchase: 'sticky' ($299 pin to top), 'newsletter' ($99 weekly email feature)

tools.name: check_job_payment_status
tools.description: Check the payment status of a job posting. Use the session_id returned from create_company_job, update_company_job or purchase_job_extras with extras. No authentication required.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List all your messaging conversations with last message preview. Shows conversation status (awaiting reply, new reply, read). Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get full message history for a conversation. Accepts room_name or talent_slug. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

tools.name: start_conversation
tools.description: Start a conversation with a candidate by talent slug, optionally with a first message. If the conversation already exists, returns it. Use search_talent to find candidates first, then use their slug here. A first message takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is created or sent, and the reply is a preview of the exact text with a confirm_token; calling again with the same message and that token sends it. The candidate reads it as coming from the user's company and it can't be unsent, so show the user the preview and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

talent_slug.description: Talent slug of the candidate to message (from search_talent results)

message.description: Optional initial message to send with the conversation

confirm_token.description: Leave out to get a preview; nothing is sent. Pass the token from that preview, with the same message, to send it

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message in an existing conversation. Accepts room_name (from list_conversations) or talent_slug (from search_talent). Use start_conversation first if no conversation exists yet. Sending takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is sent, and the reply is a preview of the exact text with a confirm_token; calling again with the same message and that token sends it. The candidate reads it as coming from the user's company and it can't be unsent, so show the user the preview and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

confirm_token.description: Leave out to get a preview; nothing is sent. Pass the token from that preview, with the same message, to send it

tools.name: mark_message_read
tools.description: Mark a message as read by its ID. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

message_id.description: Message ID to mark as read

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Delete a conversation with a candidate. Accepts room_name or talent_slug. The conversation and all its messages are deleted for everyone in it, including the candidate, and this can't be undone. Deleting takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is deleted, and the reply shows the conversation with a confirm_token; calling again with the same room_name or talent_slug and that token deletes it. Show the user the conversation and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

confirm_token.description: Leave out to see what would be deleted; nothing is deleted. Pass the token from that reply to delete it

tools.name: list_my_conversations
tools.description: List the user's job seeker inbox: conversations companies and recruiters started with them on Himalayas, newest first, with the last message and whether it needs a reply. For an employer's conversations with candidates, use list_conversations. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_my_conversation
tools.description: Read the latest 30 messages in one conversation in the user's job seeker inbox. Message text is quoted as the sender wrote it. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Send a reply in a conversation in the user's job seeker inbox. Sending takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is sent, and the reply is a preview of the exact text with a confirm_token; calling again with the same message and that token sends it. The company reads it as coming from the user and it can't be unsent, so show the user the preview and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

message.description: The reply, exactly as the user approved it

confirm_token.description: Leave out to get a preview; nothing is sent. Pass the token from that preview, with the same message, to send it

tools.name: mark_my_message_read
tools.description: Mark a message in the user's job seeker inbox as read. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.
